pageTitle: Rhode Island Lottery Results and Winning Numbers

items.question: How old must I be to play the Rhode-Island lottery?
items.answer: The legally required minimum age to participate in the Lottery is 18 years.

items.question: Where can I buy a lottery ticket in Rhode-Island?
items.answer: You can buy lottery tickets from participating retail outlets.

items.question: Where do I find the Rhode-Island Lottery winning numbers?
items.answer: They’re published on state-level official sources online. Always refer to these sources to confirm the Rhode-Island lottery results. The winning numbers are also immediately available on the app.

items.question: When is the Rhode-Island Lottery Mega Millions draw?
items.answer: The Mega Millions draw takes place weekly on Tuesdays and Fridays at 11 pm.

items.question: Does it offer scratch cards?
items.answer: Yes, you can buy Rhode-Island instant-win scratch tickets from all participating retail outlets.

items.question: How do winners claim their prizes?
items.answer: All prizes of less than $600 can be claimed directly from any participating retail outlet, or at the Lottery’s head office. All prizes over $600 must be requested directly from the Lottery’s headquarters at The Rhode-Island Lottery Headquarters, 1425 Pontiac Ave, Cranston, RI 02920

items.question: Is there a Rhode-Island Lottery app I can use?
items.answer:
Yes. You can download the app from PlayStore. It offers additional features for group activities.

items.question: What are my odds of winning the Rhode-Island Lottery?
items.answer: The odds are 1 in 292 201 338 to win the jackpot.

items.question: Who won the biggest Rhode-Island Lottery?
items.answer: In March 2012, an incredible Powerball jackpot worth $336.4 million was won by the 81-year-old Louise White.

items.question: How do I play the Rhode-Island Lottery & can I play online?
items.answer: You can participate by buying lottery tickets or scratch cards from several participating retailers. The Rhode-Island Lottery does not sell any tickets online, over the phone, or by email.

items.question: Will I pay tax if I win a Rhode-Island Lottery jackpot?
items.answer:
You’ll have to pay both state and federal taxes. All winners of more than $600 will be required to complete a W-2 form when a prize claim is made.

Up to 35.99% is withheld for State and Federal Taxes.

items.question: How much time do I have to collect my prize if I win the Rhode-Island Lottery?
items.answer: You will be allowed 12 months (365 days) from the Lottery results date to claim your winning prize.

items.question: What happens to all the proceeds from the Rhode-Island Lottery?
items.answer:
The money is applied to maintain the operations of the Lottery by paying commissions and prize money. The remainder is put towards the General

Fund, which supports various initiatives such as transport, public safety, education, and natural resources.

items.question: Can I remain anonymous if I win the Rhode-Island Lottery?
items.answer: Unfortunately not, as this information falls under the Freedom of Information Act. Should you wish to remain anonymous, it is advisable to discuss claiming it through a trust with your legal team.

items.question: Is there a Rhode-Island Lottery second chance with the same ticket?
items.answer: Yes. But it is reserved for VIP members only. Using their Rhode-Island Lottery codes, tickets that did not win can be re-entered for an additional draw by using the Rhode-Island Lottery ticket scanner to enter the code.
